title: Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities Product Specifications — Issue Ages, Premiums and Tax Registrations
content:
**New business specification sheet — Fixed Indexed Annuities**

The issue ages below are the lowest and highest ages at which both the owner and the annuitant may be issued a contract on that tier. Issue age is the age last birthday on the issue date. Premium amounts are in US dollars.

| Specification | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest issue age | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 40 | 40 |
| Highest issue age | 85 | 85 | 80 | 80 | 80 | 79 |
| Smallest initial premium, non-qualified (USD) | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 |
| Smallest initial premium, IRA (USD) | 5000 | 5000 | 5000 | 25000 | 25000 | 25000 |
| Largest total premium on one contract without home office approval (USD) | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 | 1000000 |
| Additional premium window (calendar months from the issue date) | 0 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Smallest additional premium within the window (USD) | 0 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |

A window of 0 months marks a single premium tier: the Ashgrove IndexEdge 5 accepts no additional premium after issue, and its smallest additional premium is shown as 0 for that reason.

### Tax registrations

Every tier may be issued as one of four registrations: non-qualified, traditional IRA, Roth IRA or SEP IRA.

### Notes on the table

- The IRA premium column applies to the traditional, Roth and SEP IRA registrations; the non-qualified column applies to a non-qualified contract.
- On the IndexEdge 10 Bonus and both IncomeShield tiers the smallest initial premium is the same, 25000, whichever registration is chosen.
- The two IncomeShield tiers have a lowest issue age of 40; the four IndexEdge tiers have none above 0.

### Hypothetical lookups

| Hypothetical case | Reading of the table |
|---|---|
| Owner and annuitant both aged 79 last birthday, Ashgrove IncomeShield 10 | Within the issue ages (40 to 79) |
| Owner aged 80 last birthday, Ashgrove IncomeShield 10 | Above the highest issue age of 79 |
| Owner aged 80 last birthday, Ashgrove IncomeShield 7 | Within the issue ages (40 to 80) |
| Initial premium of 8000 on a traditional IRA, Ashgrove IndexEdge 7 | At least the IRA minimum of 5000 |
| Initial premium of 8000, non-qualified, Ashgrove IndexEdge 7 | Below the non-qualified minimum of 10000 |
